name: Bar Kokhba State
alt: Jewish state of the Bar Kokhba revolt

predecessors.name: Roman Empire
predecessors.text: the province of Judaea, of which the rebels held 'all of Judea proper'

successors.name: Roman Empire
successors.text: Judaea, which Hadrian merged with Galilee and Samaria 'into the new province of Syria Palaestina' (Simon bar Kokhba page)

ledger.x: 132: the Bar Kokhba revolt founds a Jewish state.
135: Betar falls and the state ends.

wars.name: Bar Kokhba revolt
wars.outcome: Roman victory: Betar was besieged in summer 135 and captured and destroyed; Bar Kokhba was killed; the conflict persisted 'at least until January 136' (Zissu) or ended 'in early 136' (Eck); Jews were expelled from Jerusalem and its district.

certainty.note: The held territory is a scholars' reading of coinage and letters, not a boundary.
